text: dsh-no-phone-home 是面向 DSH 的 bundle 补丁，会将共享 OTLP、会话遥测、会话日志和插件清单附加、产品分析及反馈收集相关行设为禁用。安装到 profile 后由 DSH 应用补丁；附带的检查工具可组合 profile 补丁层并报告仍启用的遥测行。适合希望调整 DSH 诊断与反馈行为的用户。不需要 API 密钥或额外账号；可选设置 DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1，继续关闭会话遥测。

dsh-no-phone-home disables DSH telemetry, session logs, plugin inventory, analytics, and feedback rows through a profile bundle patch. Its checker reports enabled telemetry rows. No API key or account is needed; DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 is optional.
想关闭 DSH 自动附带的会话记录。
有没有办法停用产品遥测相关插件行？
我希望模型请求不要再附上当前插件清单。
把消息评分和反馈入口从 DSH 里关掉。
怎么让 DSH profile 不启用共享 OTLP 遥测传输？
How can I turn off session telemetry in my DSH profile?
I want to stop DSH from attaching its plugin inventory to model requests.
Can I disable the feedback and message rating features in DSH?
dsh-no-phone-home 的功能「关闭遥测传输」：补丁将共享 OTLP 传输和会话遥测行设为禁用，作为 DSH bundle 补丁层应用。
dsh-no-phone-home 的功能「关闭请求附加数据」：补丁停用会话日志和插件库存行，避免它们作为这些行的功能继续附加到请求中。
dsh-no-phone-home 的功能「关闭反馈收集」：补丁停用 /feedback、消息反馈和界面评分相关行，触发方式是安装并应用此 bundle 补丁。

dsh-no-phone-home README · dsh-no-phone-home：Stops [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) from phoning home. This is a patch-only bundle: it ships no runtime code, it only disables the shipped plugin rows that send data off your machine for DeepSeek's diagnostics, or that record data so it can be sent later.

dsh-no-phone-home README · What it disables：| Row | What it does when enabled |
|---|---|
| `session-telemetry-otel` | Exports session-log prefixes to `dsh-otel-collector.deepseeksvc.com` whenever you leave feedback (`/feedback`, or rating a message). In the shipped default mode (`FEEDBACK_ONLY`), a single thumbs-up uploads the session up to that point: message text, tool arguments and results, and workspace paths. |
| `otel` | The shared OTLP transport used by session and product telemetry. |
| `session-log-deepseek` | Attaches an incremental copy of the session log (`dsh_session_log`, up to 8 MiB) to every request sent to the official DeepSeek API. |
| `plugin-package-inventory-deepseek` | Attaches your active plugin list (`dsh_plugin_packages`) to every request sent to the official DeepSeek API. |
| `desktop-product-telemetry`, `product-analytics` | Desktop product analytics and its OTLP exporter. Upstream enables these only in the desktop profile; this bundle disables them in every profile. |
| `command-feedback`, `message-feedback`, `ui-message-feedback` | `/feedback`, message ratings and notes. These records exist to authorize and feed the telemetry upload; with it off they w

dsh-no-phone-home README · What it disables：Older dsh releases lack some of these rows (`otel` and the desktop rows arrived after 0.1.7-rc.2). dsh skips a patch for a row it doesn't have, so the bundle works on either.

Patches target row ids only. A patch that also names the package is skipped when upstream moves an id to a different package, which would silently re-enable the row.

dsh-no-phone-home README · Not covered：- **DeepSeek API request headers.** The DeepSeek model adapter (`llm-deepseek`, `llm-deepseek-account`) sends `x-deepseek-harness-user-id` (a random id stored in `$DSH_HOME/.anonymous-user-id`) and `x-deepseek-harness-session-id` with each model request. These go only to the DeepSeek endpoint you're already sending prompts to, and only when you use a DeepSeek route. Routes through other adapters, such as the OpenAI-compatible `llm-pi-ai`, send no such headers. Removing them would need a code change in dsh itself.
- **Features you use on purpose.** Sign-in to a DeepSeek account and DeepSeek web search talk to DeepSeek when you use them. They are not telemetry, so this bundle leaves them alone.

dsh-no-phone-home README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mattcarvercom/dsh-no-phone-home#v1.0.0
```

This installs the bundle and adds it to the profile's bundle list. With HMR active (the default for `web`), it applies to a running `dsh web` without a restart; otherwise restart dsh. You can also toggle it from the Plugins page.

dsh-no-phone-home README · Install：For defense in depth, also set `DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` in the environment that launches dsh. dsh applies that switch after every patch layer, including the profile patch the Plugins page writes, so it keeps `session-telemetry-otel` off even if that row is switched back on in the UI.

dsh-no-phone-home README · Verify：From a clone of this repo:

```sh
npm run check   # audits ~/.dsh/profiles/web as dsh would compose it right now
npm test        # checks the patch against your installed dsh; run after every dsh upgrade
```

Both find dsh through the `dsh` on your PATH. Set `DSH_PACKAGE_DIR` to an installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh` package, or `DSH_CHECKOUT` to a source checkout, to use a different one. `check` also accepts a profile directory as its argument and honors `DSH_HOME`.

dsh-no-phone-home README · Verify：`check` composes the real layers in dsh's order: each bundle, the profile patch, `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`, then `DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED`. It exits 1 if any denied row is enabled, if the bundle isn't mounted, or if an enabled row's package name looks like telemetry but isn't covered. A row counts as disabled only when `disabled` is literally `true`; a conditional (`!!js`) value doesn't count. Rows your dsh version doesn't have are listed as `absent`.

dsh-no-phone-home README · Verify：`npm test` checks the patch against the `base` and `web-app` bundles of your installed dsh. It fails if a denied package moved to a new row id, if the patch stops being id-only, or if the composed result isn't clean. It also confirms the audit really catches the shipped defaults, a later re-enable, and a new telemetry-shaped row.

Tested with dsh 0.2.2-alpha.2 from a source checkout (`d3c34b7`), on Node 25.8.0.
